title: The Understudy
subtitle: One rope, one cue, one person who knew both
briefing: During a preview performance, a counterweight bar falls onto the stage a metre from the lead actress, Delia Mount. Nobody is hurt. The rigging is inspected and the securing pin is found on the fly floor, removed rather than sheared. Only someone who knew the cue sheet would know when Delia stood on that mark.
solution: Gareth Tull, the deputy stage manager, pulled the pin during the interval. He calls the cues, so he knew to the second where Delia would be standing. His motive was the understudy, Kirsty, to whom he had promised the part. The frayed rope that suggested neglect was on a different line entirely, and the missing maintenance signature was a clerical lapse from two months earlier.

topics.interval: where they were during the interval

suspects.name: Gareth Tull
suspects.motive: Promised the lead role to the understudy, whom he is involved with.

statements.question: Where were you during the interval?
statements.text: At the prompt corner, marking up act two. I never left it.

statements.question: Who knows the cue sheet?
statements.text: Anyone on comms. It is not a secret document.

statements.question: Who can reach the fly floor?
statements.text: Flys and technical staff. It is signed and restricted.

suspects.name: Kirsty Vale
suspects.motive: Directly benefits if the lead cannot perform.

statements.question: Where were you during the interval?
statements.text: In the dressing room with two other people. Ask them.

statements.question: Who knows the cue sheet?
statements.text: I know the blocking. I do not know the technical cues.

statements.question: Who can reach the fly floor?
statements.text: Not performers. I have never been up there.

suspects.name: Harry Dunn
suspects.motive: Responsible for the maintenance record that has a gap in it.

statements.question: Where were you during the interval?
statements.text: On the fly floor, resetting for act two. That is my job.

statements.question: Who knows the cue sheet?
statements.text: Everyone on comms hears the cues called.

statements.question: Who can reach the fly floor?
statements.text: Restricted, but the door is propped half the night. It should not be.

suspects.name: Delia Mount
suspects.motive: Reported a stalker to the theatre a month ago and was not taken seriously.

statements.question: Where were you during the interval?
statements.text: Stage left, in the wings, going over the second act with the director.

statements.question: Who knows the cue sheet?
statements.text: I know my own marks. That is all any of us know.

statements.question: Who can reach the fly floor?
statements.text: I would not know how to get up there.
